comment: 47yo female, germline RAD51C pathogenic variant confirmed on multi-gene HBOC panel ordered after sister diagnosed with high-grade serous ovarian cancer at age 55 (RAD51C-positive on tumor testing). No personal cancer. Childbearing complete. RAD51C/D paralogs partner BRCA1/2 in HR; carriers have moderate-to-high-penetrance ovarian cancer (RR ~5.9 RAD51C, ~6.6 RAD51D; lifetime ~10-20%) approaching BRCA levels, modest breast signal. Fires RF-RAD51C-D-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: ovarian, breast). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-RAD51C-D-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (RRSO at completed childbearing or age 45-50 per NCCN + individualised breast surveillance with MRI consideration); alternative = IND-RAD51C-D-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + symptom-driven workup, declining RRSO).
